entries.originalConcern: After Storage accepted a Client upload, an unconfirmed signed session commit or finalization failure could return uploaded_but_needs_attention with no asset ID and no durable exception receipt. The portal then cleared the selected file and told the Client not to retry even though the initiated session could expire and its orphaned object become deletable.
entries.freshVerificationResult: A null-asset attention outcome can now cross the data boundary only with a validated team_exception_recorded receipt. Every missing or unconfirmed receipt throws a typed media_upload_retry_required error; the Client portal rechecks that invariant before clearing state, retains the selected file and attestation, skips refresh, and gives explicit same-file retry guidance. Registered replay sessions use their known asset and rights IDs through the registered-asset finalizer, so durable assets retain Team-owned recovery behavior without an unnecessary Client retry.
entries.rootCause: The upload adapter modeled all post-Storage failures as the same success-style attention handoff and discarded the distinction between a durable registered asset or exception receipt and an initiated session with no durable recovery ownership.
entries.correctiveAction: Centralize the durable-attention invariant, throw a typed retry error for every null-asset outcome without a durable Team receipt, defensively enforce the same rule before portal state clearing, and route already-registered sessions through asset finalization with their known durable IDs.
